QuestInfo.name: The End of an Era
QuestInfo.0: The allies are victorious, Honnou-ji has been recaptured, but Nobunaga is gone. Return to Tsuchimikado Haruaki and see if there is anything else you can do.
QuestInfo.2: Wherever Nobunaga is, he will not be resting. Train hard and prepare for the day you come face to face. The era of war is over, but the era of peace will need a leader...
